blocks.text: Bimby Aquino, 19, shared his dream of getting married young and expressed his hope that his mom, Kris Aquino, would still be able to walk him down the aisle. Bimby opened up about his love life during his and his mother’s guest appearance on “Fast Talk with Boy Abunda” on Thursday, Oct. 29. While the young celebrity clarified that he is single and has yet to have a girlfriend, he admitted that he has female friends and Kris hopes he will eventually settle down. “My mom would have wanted me to date but it has never progressed,” he said.
